final_message: Fixed the source-position collision in Java 11’s type-inference cache: Lombok had assigned every default-initializer expression the annotation’s position. The fix preserves original initializer positions while marking only generated provider nodes, covering both `@Builder` and `@SuperBuilder`. Added regression coverage and a changelog entry.
